sources.scope: FL-08 pressure state, once-per-Watch source categories and two-credit reduction cap, Risk floor, safe-Haven settlement and no reset; FL-09 no-roll endpoints, d6 classification and bounded complications; FL-10 actual route identity, mapping, quality, Risk and Capacity authorities; TR-13 route-quality check modifier.

implementation.name: Schema68 TEST_ONLY Expedition Pressure lifecycle and causal-history correction (no save-layout change)
responsibilities: Persist one fixed cohort's pressure provenance, route exposures, source-linked category changes and immutable Watch checkpoints.
Settle pressure through the shared RuleClock and deterministic RNG, using actual route profile facts and attack receipts.
Apply the reviewed TEST_ONLY route obstruction, route closure and existing-path retreat outcomes.
Validate each immutable checkpoint against source history available at its causal revision and derive late same-Watch category carry-forward without a second checkpoint or roll.
Resolve attack exposure membership by receipt order, including a committed departure opportunity attack.
authorities: ExpeditionRouteTravelRecord and the selected TestOnlyExpeditionRouteFixture own route progress, geometry, mapping, physical quality, Risk and Capacity.
MeleeAttackRecord and RangedAttackRecord plus canonical command receipts own attack evidence.
RuleClock, shared DiceStream, SnapshotCodec and command history own timing, randomness, persistence and deterministic replay.
Camp Greens work and the existing WorkLedger remain independent shared-clock work authorities during obstruction.
notImplemented: Capacity-exceeded, missing/captured members, pursuit, abort triggers, exposed camps and Attention cargo pressure producers.
Counter-Ambush, concealed-camp, pursuit-ending and reconnaissance pressure reductions.
Minor complications in runtime: the source gate requires an applied modifier or reroll, which this bounded profile does not provide.

Production expedition roster, Pressure persistence beyond this TEST_ONLY fixed cohort, arbitrary route/camp/Haven content, extraction, enemy encounters, damage, evacuation and cargo/casualty consequences.
The pressure fixture explicitly treats TEST_ONLY PlotId as a safe-Haven endpoint for boundary tests; this grants no Haven service or production safe-site authority.
